title: How to Get Voice Task with Codex MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Codex MCP and Medux to return the current state of a voice cloning task, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.
operation: Return the current state of a voice cloning task.
prompt: Use Medux to run Get Voice Task. Review the required inputs, call medux_get_voice_task, wait for the result if a task is returned, and report the output clearly.

fields.name: task_id
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.
